nodes.name: Issue Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives `{matter_id, hold_id, custodian_list_source, notice_template_path}` from the legal-ops platform when counsel marks a hold ready to issue. Manual trigger via curl is also acceptable for first-issue workflows.

parameters.query:
SELECT custodian_id, full_name, email, slack_user_id, manager_email, last_updated_at
FROM custodian_registry
WHERE matter_id = $1
  AND active = true
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

nodes.name: Load Custodian List
nodes.notes: Pulls active custodians for the matter. Replace with HTTP node if your custodian source is in Relativity / Everlaw / Logikcull. Schema returned must match: custodian_id, full_name, email, slack_user_id (optional), manager_email.

nodes.name: Personalize Notice
nodes.notes: Loads the per-matter notice template, computes SHA for the audit log, generates a unique acknowledgement token + URL per custodian. The token is what makes acknowledgements custodian-specific.

parameters.subject: LEGAL HOLD: Action Required — Matter {{ $json.matter_id }}
parameters.html:
={{ $json.personalized_text }}

Click here to acknowledge receipt of this hold notice

nodes.name: Send Hold Email
nodes.notes: Hold notices may flag the existence of a litigation matter. Use the firm's own mail relay (not a third-party SaaS like SendGrid) for confidentiality.

nodes.name: Send Hold Slack DM
nodes.notes: Slack DM is intentionally vague — does not name the matter. Custodian gets details from email. The DM exists to ensure the email isn't missed in inbox-overflow scenarios.

parameters.columns: hold_id, custodian_id, action, template_sha, payload_json, created_at

nodes.name: Audit: Notice Sent
nodes.notes: Append-only by DB constraint (REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE on this table). Counsel's defensibility depends on this; do not work around the constraint.
